description: data/ui/fonts.json (UH-6, D5): the 7 font presets engine/render/fonts.py's _FONT_SPECS ships, as schema-checked committed data. Loaded once at boot (game/main.py) and passed to engine.render.fonts.configure_fonts, which rebinds the font cache's point size/bold pair per key; the unconfigured module defaults equal this file's stock content (tools/tests/test_theme_data.py pins it). Font size changes drawn glyphs only — the pinned layout_h table (engine/render/fonts.py) never reads this file, so stored layout rects are unaffected and text can overflow its widget if enlarged (the Theme panel says so). All 7 keys are required: the game names them by key, so a missing one would silently break a screen. Adding a NEW preset key is a schema change, deliberately out of scope for v1 (the fixed set).

hud_phase.description: HUD phase-banner readout, bottom-left of the game screen.

lg.description: Large UI text size (bold) — headings, button labels, panel titles.

md.description: Default/medium UI text size — most labels, buttons and readouts.

sm.description: Smallest UI text size — dense labels, wrapped body text, footer notes.

xl.description: Extra-large UI text size (bold) — screen titles.

xxl.description: Largest UI text size (bold) — the main menu title / big banners.
